svg.title: Toolkit
svg.desc: Toolkit of 11 tools with Python at the core and the rest orbiting around it: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, HTML5, CSS, Node.js, Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions. Beside it, a floating Red Bull can: fueled by Red Bull — late nights, big ideas.

g.text: Everything else orbits around it, from
the web stack to shipping with Git.
